home.heroSub: Twelve climates on one small island. We draw unhurried routes through tea country, leopard territory and the old ports of the south — led by the people who live there.
home.manifestoLead: We plan the way a local would — slowly, and with one person in mind.
home.signatureTitle: A planner, not a call centre
home.manifestoSide: No two travellers want the same island. A planner in Colombo takes your first note and stays with you until the last night — reworking the route around the weather, the festivals and whatever you fell for on day three.
home.chaptersIntro: Choose the landscape that pulls you in. Each chapter opens a different rhythm of the island, from ancient stone to warm southern water.
home.chaptersHint: Move across the landscapes to explore
home.experiencesHeading: Ways to spend a day here
home.experiencesIntro: Every journey is built from days like these — never more than two in a row.
home.atlasIntro: A route is more than a line between hotels. We shape each one around altitude, monsoon, light and the people worth stopping for.

manifestoStats.label: One planner from first note to last night

experiences.title: Wild encounters
experiences.copy: Leave before the park gates open. Our naturalists read the tracks, the alarm calls and the light — then wait, quietly, in the right place.

experiences.title: Tea country
experiences.copy: Walk an estate with the people who pick it, watch the withering lofts fill, and drink the first flush before it ever reaches a crate.

experiences.title: Ocean rituals
experiences.copy: A cove with no name, a table set in the sand, and the long blue hour the south coast keeps to itself.

experiences.title: Living heritage
experiences.copy: Ancient cities before the buses arrive, temple drums at dusk, and workshops where crafts have not changed hands in generations.

voices.quote: They did not hand us an itinerary. They asked what we liked, then quietly rebuilt three days of it while we slept through a monsoon.
voices.name: Marte & Idris
voices.trip: The Island in Slow Motion — 12 days

voices.quote: Our guide grew up two valleys from the estate we walked. That is the whole difference, and you feel it by the second morning.
voices.name: Hannah Weiss

voices.quote: We sat with a tracker for forty minutes in complete silence before the leopard came down. Nobody rushed us. Nobody ever did.
voices.name: The Okonkwo family

about.heroAlt: A path through the Sri Lankan forest
about.intro: We started ReiseCeylon to share Sri Lanka with the care, nuance and humanity it deserves.
about.quote: The best journeys do not make a place feel consumed. They make it feel understood.
about.copy: Our team brings together local travel designers, hosts, naturalists and storytellers. We work with independent stays and responsible partners, choosing depth over volume and lasting relationships over quick transactions.
about.card1Copy: Decisions are made here, with knowledge shaped by seasons and lived experience.
about.card2Copy: We recommend fewer places and know them more deeply.
about.card3Copy: Your journey should benefit the people and landscapes that make it possible.

highlights.title: The essential view
highlights.copy: Arrive before the day gathers pace and see the landscape in its softest light.

highlights.title: A local table
highlights.copy: Share seasonal food and conversation in a setting selected for character, not spectacle.

highlights.title: Room to wander
highlights.copy: A generous afternoon with a thoughtful route and no obligation to hurry.

stages.title: Begin in the old kingdoms
stages.copy: Arrive gently, settle into the island and follow ancient paths through forest and stone.

stages.title: Move with the hills
stages.copy: Take the slow train into tea country, walk the estates and dine by the fire as mist gathers.

stages.title: Follow the road south
stages.copy: Trade mountain air for the coast, stopping at makers, markets and a secluded stay by the sea.

stages.title: End without hurrying
stages.copy: Leave the final days open for saltwater, long lunches and one last Sri Lankan sunset.

defaults.destinationIntroHeading:
Come for the landscape.
Stay for its quieter stories.
defaults.destinationIntroCopy: {name} is more than a point on a map. We pair its essential landmarks with time to wander, meet people and notice the details that make a place memorable.
defaults.destinationGoodToKnowHeading: Best from December to April, beautiful in every season.
defaults.destinationGoodToKnowCopy: We plan around weather, local festivals and your preferred pace. Private transfers, handpicked stays, trusted guides and 24/7 in-country support can all be woven into your journey.
defaults.tourIntroHeading:
A route with direction,
never a rigid schedule.
defaults.tourIntroCopy: Every stay, transfer and encounter is handled. The rhythm remains spacious, and every detail can be changed around your interests.
defaults.tourIncludedCopy: Handpicked accommodation, daily breakfast, private transport, specialist hosts, selected experiences and 24/7 local assistance are included. International flights and travel insurance are excluded.
defaults.seoDescription: Discover {name} in {area}, Sri Lanka, with key highlights, nearby places and practical details for planning your visit.

sigiriya-day-out.title: Sigiriya in a Day
sigiriya-day-out.note: Leave the city before five, climb the rock before the heat, and be back by dark.

kandy-day-out.title: Kandy & the Temple Road
kandy-day-out.note: The old capital, its gardens, and the evening drums at the Temple of the Tooth.

southern-shore-day.title: The Southern Shore
southern-shore-day.note: Turtles at Kosgoda, reef at Hikkaduwa and a long lunch above Unawatuna bay.

cultural-triangle-short.title: The Cultural Triangle
cultural-triangle-short.note: Three days among rock temples, ruined capitals and the elephants of Minneriya.

hill-country-short.title: Into the Hill Country
hill-country-short.note: The blue train, tea above the cloud line and two mornings in the Ella gap.

wild-south-short.title: The Wild South
wild-south-short.note: Two parks, one leopard if the light is kind, and the coast to recover on.

island-in-slow-motion.title: The Island in Slow Motion
island-in-slow-motion.note: Tea trails, quiet estates and mornings above the cloud line.

wild-ceylon.title: Wild Ceylon
wild-ceylon.note: Wild landscapes shaped around patient, respectful encounters.

heritage-and-horizon.title: Heritage & Horizon
heritage-and-horizon.note: Old cities, southern ramparts and long evenings beside the sea.
